name: rationale-toolkit
description: Rationale-first coding style and outcome-verification discipline for Claude Code: explain the why before the what, and prove changes work before calling them done. Ships an optional ELI15 output style for plain-language explanations that always state what changed and what the user must do next, a hook that blocks direct node_modules/.bin/ invocations, and a hook that puts every git push behind approval and denies force pushes.
